title: Research: one-repeat transfer-coupled (5,1,1) obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 1 of [#2836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2836) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): do non-distinct (one-repeat) label layers inside a transfer-coupled `(5,1,1)` schedule improve on distinct-label `R=84`?

| Layer | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff at X=0,C=1 | Undercuts 436? | Beats distinct 84? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Distinct-label (#2836 / #2817) | 8749440 | **84** | ≥439 (needs X≥2) | no | — |
| Prefix-internal double | **2499840** | **98** | **463** | **no** | **no** |
| Suffix–prefix collision | **1666560** | **96** | **459** | **no** | **no** |
| Combined one-repeat | **4166400** | **96** | **459** | **no** | **no** |

Every covering one-repeat dual has `R∈{96,98}`. Combined minimum is `R=96`, strictly worse than the distinct-label floor `84`. Abstract tariff `38·7+2·96+1=459>436` already at `X=0`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2840) / [#2836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2836) / [#2817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2817) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q/`.
Tip: `90d879d143f9570c140d105a5cc60f445766d852`.

Exact: combined one-repeat min R **96** (tariff floor **459**); no undercut of 436; does not beat distinct-label 84.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_ONEREPEAT_7Q_OBSTRUCTION combined_min_R=96 ... tariff_floor=459 ... answers_all_shapes_oq1_onerepeat no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_TRANSFER_COUPLED_ONEREPEAT_7Q ... tariff_floor=459 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_ONEREPEAT_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/transfer-coupled-onerepeat-7q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes. Requires `gcc` for local `dual.c` (Python fallback available).
